data_is_synthetic: Exposure portfolio is synthetic (starter kit). Hazard is a terrain-based proxy, not measured flood depth.

H1_tier_to_return_period.statement: Smallest footprint tier (file 'extreme', 5% of cells) is the most frequent scenario; largest footprint (file 'common', 40%) is the rarest. Return periods 5/10/25/100/250 years are assumed.

H2_depth_conversion.statement: depth_m = DEPTH_REFERENCE_M * max(0, S - t_k); S=1 in the rarest scenario corresponds to 4 m (document example).

V1_reference_curve.source: Huizinga, de Moel & Szewczyk (2017), JRC EUR 28552 EN, residential, Africa

informal_iron_sheet.rationale: single-storey, light materials, contents at floor level

permanent_masonry.rationale: reference class: closest to JRC residential building

concrete_rcc.rationale: often multi-storey; only lower floors affected

financial_engine: loss = damage_ratio * tiv_kes per building per scenario; portfolio loss = sum over buildings; AAL by trapezoidal integration of the EP curve (loss assumed zero for events more frequent than the 5-year scenario and flat beyond 250 years).
